package consumer_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.invalid/drawer-proof/converted"
	"golang.org/x/net/html"
)

func render(t *testing.T, component interface {
	Render(context.Context, io.Writer) error
}) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := component.Render(context.Background(), &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("render failed")
	}
	return out.Bytes()
}

func writeExclusive(t *testing.T, name string, body []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	f, err := os.OpenFile(name, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("output must be absent")
	}
	_, writeErr := f.Write(body)
	closeErr := f.Close()
	if writeErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
		t.Fatal("output failed")
	}
}

func hasForbiddenElement(body []byte) bool {
	z := html.NewTokenizer(bytes.NewReader(body))
	for {
		switch z.Next() {
		case html.ErrorToken:
			return z.Err() != io.EOF
		case html.StartTagToken, html.SelfClosingTagToken:
			name, _ := z.TagName()
			if bytes.Equal(name, []byte("script")) || bytes.Equal(name, []byte("form")) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
}

// Synthetic app-owned render task, not a profile backend or browser certification.
func TestDeliveredDrawerConsumer(t *testing.T) {
	for _, canary := range []struct {
		body string
		want bool
	}{
		{`<!-- Reference instruction: <script src="/runtime.js"></script> -->`, false},
		{`<span>&lt;script&gt;</span>`, false},
		{`<script src="/runtime.js"></script>`, true},
		{`<form action="/mutate"></form>`, true},
	} {
		if hasForbiddenElement([]byte(canary.body)) != canary.want {
			t.Fatal("element oracle lost executable/comment distinction")
		}
	}
	body, err := os.ReadFile("converted/defaults.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("delivered defaults missing")
	}
	var data converted.Drawer
	if json.Unmarshal(body, &data) != nil {
		t.Fatal("delivery defaults invalid")
	}
	if data.IDPrefix != "" || data.ImageURL != "" || data.OnlineLabel != "" || data.Primary != nil || data.Secondary != nil || len(data.MenuLinks) != 0 || len(data.Details) != 4 {
		t.Fatal("defaults invented app-owned state or changed shape")
	}
	if _, err := converted.NewDrawer(data); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unbound ID/image accepted")
	}
	data.IDPrefix, data.ImageURL = "person", "/photo.svg"
	readonly, err := converted.NewDrawer(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("read-only constructor failed")
	}
	readonlyBody := render(t, readonly)
	if bytes.Contains(readonlyBody, []byte("href=")) || bytes.Contains(readonlyBody, []byte("el-dropdown")) {
		t.Fatal("read-only drawer invented an action")
	}
	writeExclusive(t, "readonly.html", readonlyBody)
	data.OnlineLabel = "Online in this synthetic fixture"
	data.Primary = &converted.DrawerLink{Label: "Message", URL: "/compose"}
	data.Secondary = &converted.DrawerLink{Label: "Call", URL: "/call-setup"}
	data.MenuLinks = []converted.DrawerLink{{Label: "View profile", URL: "/profile"}, {Label: "Profile history", URL: "/history"}}
	typed, err := converted.NewDrawer(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("typed constructor failed")
	}
	typedBody := render(t, typed)
	want, err := os.ReadFile("typed-oracle.html")
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(typedBody, want) {
		t.Fatal("typed render differs from exact compiler/browser oracle")
	}
	writeExclusive(t, "typed.html", typedBody)
	for _, route := range []string{"/compose", "/call-setup", "/profile", "/history"} {
		if strings.Count(string(typedBody), `href="`+route+`"`) != 1 {
			t.Fatal("native navigation binding differs")
		}
	}
	if hasForbiddenElement(typedBody) {
		t.Fatal("render inferred mutation or runtime bootstrap")
	}
	data.Primary.URL = "/changed"
	data.MenuLinks[0].URL = "/changed-menu"
	data.Details[0].Text = "Changed after construction"
	if !bytes.Equal(render(t, typed), typedBody) {
		t.Fatal("app input mutation changed the constructed snapshot")
	}
	data.IDPrefix = "second"
	second, err := converted.NewDrawer(data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("second instance construction failed")
	}
	combined := string(typedBody) + string(render(t, second))
	for _, id := range []string{"person-dialog", "person-heading", "second-dialog", "second-heading"} {
		if strings.Count(combined, `id="`+id+`"`) != 1 {
			t.Fatal("instance IDs are not isolated")
		}
	}
	data.Details[3].Date = "2026-02-30"
	if _, err := converted.NewDrawer(data); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid calendar date accepted")
	}
}
